decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:ee390284, email:ae3546a4, email:f69356e9), no tickets, no first project, no invite, no key milestone. Silent, disengaged Starter signups rarely self-activate; 8 days remain, so some chance but low.

draft.subject: One small first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

I know a new tool is easy to put off, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to see whether it fits how Clearwater Media works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to set up that first project with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Chidi
